calls.reason: TruthfulQA shows high false-answer rates for GPT-3, GPT-2 and others, but nobody has established which models Marcus had seen. InstructGPT's reported truthfulness gains make the 'every other' claim harder to call.

Launch-day records by Davis and Sundstrom show many factual errors on ordinary prompts, such as Venus transit dates and biographies. Ars Technica reported inaccuracies, and the developers' own paper scored it only 26% on TruthfulQA.

No record shows high school students using Galactica to fool or intimidate teachers. The demo was pulled within days, but the model weights were open-sourced and the forecast has no deadline, so it cannot be called decisively.
